title: salacia paniculata
intro: Salacia paniculata, commonly known as Bhasma or Salacia, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae, native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including obesity, hyperlipidemia, and type 2 diabetes, due to its potential health benefits of weight management and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Salacia paniculata are attributed to its ability to inhibit carbohydrate absorption, reduce fat accumulation, and decrease inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Salacia paniculata include salacin, salicin, and other oligosaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
